# Syntecxhub Studio

> Creative Digital Asset Management & Vector Asset Pipeline.

## Overview
Syntecxhub Studio is a next-generation Creative Digital Asset Management (DAM) platform engineered with Nuxt 4 (SSR Nitro) and NestJS (Mongoose/MongoDB). It provides high-speed vector inspection, MIME validation pipelines, drag-and-drop batch ingestion, and storage quota governance.

## Core Capabilities
- **Creative Media Asset Vault**: Instant gallery view with split metadata inspector and copyable CDN URLs.
- **SVG & Vector Processing**: Native rendering and inspection of SVG vectors alongside PNG, JPEG, WebP, and GIF.
- **MIME & Storage Telemetry**: Real-time disk quota utilization metering, per-format distribution, and multi-file batch uploads.
- **OpenAPI Architecture**: Standardized RESTful endpoints documented via Swagger / OpenAPI at `/api-docs`.

## Key URLs
- Homepage / Dashboard: https://studio.syntecxhub.com/
- Media Vault & Gallery: https://studio.syntecxhub.com/media
- Storage Preferences: https://studio.syntecxhub.com/settings
- OpenAPI Explorer: https://studio.syntecxhub.com/api-docs

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: Nuxt 4.6, Vue 3.5, Tailwind CSS, Pinia
- Backend: NestJS 11, MongoDB 8, TypeScript
- Storage: Persistent disk storage with MongoDB metadata indexing and static asset serving
